subject: Likely cause: the S18 service worker answers /api/* so page.route mocks no longer apply (WebKit)
body: Same-pattern failures on webkit-ipad-portrait with the current shared tip: cards.spec:322 (503 mock ignored, cached data shown), qbank.spec:187 (pool failure mock ignored), notebooks.spec:462 (held /api/notebooks never shows the shelf's aria-busy state), and qbank.spec:468 offline (pageerror '...api/public-config due to access control checks', '/api/qbank/pool', '/api/blocks?limit=20'). In WebKit, requests the SW makes are not routed by page.route, so any spec that mocks or holds an /api request on a SW-controlled page silently gets the real (or cached) answer. Options: let the SW pass /api/* straight to the network (cache only what offline needs, e.g. via the Dexie layer rather than the SW), or have those specs open their context with serviceWorkers: 'block'. Not S22's code; Trusted Types report-only lines are gone at the source (0 in qbank/notes/notebooks/system on webkit+firefox after e403e32).
